Market today: The mood is mixed, but the chip sector is showing strong positive momentum driven by significant AI deals and robust demand for chips in new tech like robotics. This is the real driver for your kind of names.

Your holdings: SOXL (-55.68%) and SPAL (-36.82%) are your biggest concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, meaning their decay and volatility are amplified, especially on margin. SMH (-12.53%) is also on TRIM status and warrants attention.

Watch: Keep a close eye on NVDA following the MediaTek deal, and monitor broader interest rate trends as global borrowing costs rise.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing your leveraged, underperforming positions while staying alert to opportunities in the strengthening chip sector.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL given its -55.68% loss and leveraged decay; respect its stop at 200 or adjust it tighter.
Review SPAL's -36.82% loss; as a leveraged ETF, its decay and volatility are amplified on margin.
The Nvidia AI chip deal is a strong catalyst. Consider a new buy on NVDA at its scanner entry 218.59-218.2, with a stop at 217.06.
